name: Static linear-elastic stress and safety factor
description: Solve load case LC-1 on the given geometry; report peak von Mises stress, its location, tip deflection and the safety factor against yield.

inputs.name: mesh
inputs.description: automatic or element size at the fillet (mm)

name: Mesh convergence study (three refinement levels)
description: Solve LC-1 at three fillet element sizes (1.0, 0.5, 0.25 mm); report the peak von Mises at each level and the change between the last two levels.

acceptanceRule.description: Change between the last two levels below 5%

name: Fillet radius study (proposed experiment, protocol v1)
description: Parametric sweep of the inner fillet radius (2 to 6 mm) on the refined mesh; report peak von Mises and safety factor per radius. Runs only under an approved protocol.

acceptanceRule.description: Identify the smallest radius with safety factor at least 2.0 (informational for the sweep itself)

name: Strain-gauge comparison (imported measurement)
description: Compare an imported bench measurement at the gauge location with the predicted stress at the same location.

acceptanceRule.description: Informational: measured versus predicted at the gauge location

unsupportedReason: Bench measurements are made on the customer's rig. Nothing here drives a test rig; results are imported through a measurement artifact.

name: Fatigue life estimate
description: Stress-life estimate for the fillet under cyclic application of LC-1.

acceptanceRule.description: Not defined: intake question iq-E4 (load cycles) is open

unsupportedReason: No fatigue solver is integrated. Path: import a customer-side fatigue analysis, or request an adapter once the load spectrum is known.
